item.title: Re: I Like It Could Use Some More Stuff Though.
item.content:encoded: Dunno about Grefties, but if there's one thing from the original I'd like to see brought back it'd be the elevated engine temperature, i.e. "fever". If you consider it relevant, the concept started as "contagious malfunctions" after I saw the two cars ahead of me both having the same taillight out, and developed to "flu for cars". The name in the listing only came to me around the time I was getting ready to post it, at which point I groaned at both the pun and having missed it up to that point.

item.content:encoded:
"Assistant Director Caleigh Amity Vayl"
Later towards bottom
"Deputy Director of Medicine Vayl"

Huh? I don't get it.
Is there a married couple working at the site? Why is that important?

If this change in job title on a single person was intentional (not a writing error), I didn't understand it at all and it just plain confused me, so IMHO it could stand to have something added to the piece to make whatever reason this change happened more transparent.

I'm also not sure why leaking fluids sometimes during car manufacture is considered abnormal enough to be considered anomalous… screw ups happen and liquids will spill. The "symptom" needs a little more "oomph" IMO to be flagged as anomalous.
